summary: Apply climate projections to infrastructure vulnerability, appraisal and investment decisions. Explore the five-day practical course and enquire today.
lede: Climate-resilient infrastructure appraisal helps public infrastructure planners, utility asset managers and project engineers assess climate risks to assets and services. It supports project-level investment decisions through vulnerability screening, interpretation of CMIP6 projections and uncertainty, and comparison of adaptation options. Participants also practise setting climate-aware procurement requirements, prioritizing vulnerable assets and preparing an investment brief.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for climate risk evidence, infrastructure project appraisal, asset performance or investment decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with infrastructure project planning, appraisal, engineering, public investment or utility asset management. Climate-science expertise and programming are not required. You should bring a laptop with Excel access for scenario-table exercises; no specialist coding is required.
